prompt: `mypy` (strict mode, configured in `pyproject.toml`) reports errors in `src/`. Fix them so that `mypy` passes, without `# type: ignore`, `cast`, `Any`, or changes to the mypy configuration.
bash_commands: cat pyproject.toml; git ls-files; mypy 2>&1 | tail -40
cd src/trailhead; cat -n elevation.py pace.py report.py track.py; grep -rn "None\|elevation" ../../tests | head -60; cat ../../README.md | head -60
cd ../..; grep -rn "ele\b\|TrackError" src/trailhead/plan.py src/trailhead/cli.py src/trailhead/__init__.py; cat tests/test_elevation.py tests/conftest.py; python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='src/trailhead/track.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())
''','''    def length_km(self) -> float:
        return sum(self.leg_lengths_km())

    def elevations(self) -> list[float]:
        """Elevation of every point in metres, with the gaps filled in.

        A point without an elevation takes that of the nearest earlier point that
        has one or, if there is none, of the nearest later point. A track with no
        elevations at all is a `TrackError`.
        """
        first = next((p.ele for p in self.points if p.ele is not None), None)
        if first is None:
            if not self.points:
                return []
            raise TrackError("the track has no elevations")
        filled: list[float] = []
        last = first
        for point in self.points:
            if point.ele is not None:
                last = point.ele
            filled.append(last)
        return filled
''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='src/trailhead/elevation.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("elevations = [point.ele for point in track.points]","elevations = track.elevations()")
s=s.replace("for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.points), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):","for (a, b), km in zip(pairwise(track.elevations()), track.leg_lengths_km(), strict=True):")
s=s.replace("abs(b.ele - a.ele)","abs(b - a)")
open(p,'w').write(s)
for p in ('src/trailhead/pace.py','src/trailhead/report.py'):
    s=open(p).read()
    s=s.replace("[p.ele for p in track.points]","track.elevations()").replace("[point.ele for point in track.points]","track.elevations()")
    open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q | tail -2; sed -n 20,45p src/trailhead/cli.py
printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n' > $TMPDIR/g.csv; printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n' > $TMPDIR/n.csv
for f in g n; do PYTHONPATH=src python -m trailhead summary $TMPDIR/$f.csv; echo "exit $?"; done; git diff --stat

python - <<'EOF'
p='src/trailhead/cli.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''        track = load_track(args.file)
    except (OSError, TrackError) as exc:
        print(f"trailhead: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if args.command == "summary":
        print(format_summary(summarise(track, args.fitness, args.threshold)))
    else:
        for line in describe_plan(split_days(track, args.max_hours, args.fitness)):
            print(line)
    return 0
'''
new='''        track = load_track(args.file)
        if args.command == "summary":
            lines = [format_summary(summarise(track, args.fitness, args.threshold))]
        else:
            lines = describe_plan(split_days(track, args.max_hours, args.fitness))
    except (OSError, TrackError) as exc:
        print(f"trailhead: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    for line in lines:
        print(line)
    return 0
'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
EOF

D=$(mktemp -d); printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n' > $D/g.csv; printf 'lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n' > $D/n.csv

import os,subprocess,sys,tempfile
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
open(d+'/g.csv','w').write('lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,100\n0,0.02,\n0,0.03,160\n')
open(d+'/n.csv','w').write('lat,lon,ele\n0,0,\n0,0.01,\n')
for f in 'gn':
    for c in ('summary','plan'):
        r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','trailhead',c,f'{d}/{f}.csv'],env={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':'src'},capture_output=True,text=True)
        print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)

python _fix.py; rm _fix.py; mypy; ruff check; python -m pytest -q | tail -2; git status --short
